versions.subject: wscript/cscript
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 1
    Image:
        - '*\wscript.exe'
        - '*\cscript.exe'
    CommandLine:
        - '*.jse'
        - '*.vbe'
        - '*.js'
        - '*.vba'
        - '*.vbe'
condition: selection
